observations.what: After a flip, the invisible previous sleeve (opacity 0) sits over the lower crate panel, so clicking the crate tape label moves back one record. Pre-existing.

On a phone the crate traps scrolling: .scene is full width with touch-action none, so a swipe on it never scrolls, and Pull it out is below the fold at 390x740. A 150px swipe also jumps from 1/4 to 4/4. Pre-existing CSS.
Empty crate: "Empty crate" text is nearly unreadable on the dark panel, panels float apart, and the flip hint still shows.
When a crate has a label, the crate page shows the label twice (h1 and tape) and never its name, e.g. "Thrift Bin Psych" appears only on the Home card. This follows the spec (label ?? name).
"Back to the crates" on the album page goes to /shelf, so the picker returns after visiting a /crates/:id record. Known follow-up.
/crates/9999 has no h1 and keeps the title "Crates · Frisson"; /shelf and /list have no h1.
/shelf at phone width with 10 crates: the tabs fill the viewport and the crate starts off screen. Known limit.
After Back from an album, focus is on body rather than the crate.
